examined.reason: spa-plus-express: Vite React TS SPA with RTK Query endpoints (5 in redux/features/books/booksApi.ts, 2 in orders/ordersApi.ts) plus 3 axios calls to `${getBaseUrl()}/api/...`; Express mounts /api/books, /api/orders, /api/auth, /api/admin routers in backend/index.js; ~10 requests; ~56 files

env-api-urls: Vite React TS SPA whose fetch wrappers request()/requestAuth() in frontend/src/api/client.ts build VITE_API_BASE || '/api' + path and VITE_AUTH_BASE || '/auth' + path (~30 one-line methods); Express mounts /auth and /api/* routers in backend/src/presentation/http/app.ts; pnpm workspace; ~260 files
Rule 3 (receiving side): a client-only CRA repo with no server code; every fetch goes to the deployed hospital-management-server-one.vercel.app
Rule 4 (calling side): only 4 fetch call sites in client/src, two of them to Prometheus ('prometheus', BrokersContainer's resource); 2 reach server/index.js's Express routes

axios-baseurl: CRA SPA with axios.create({ baseURL: process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL }) instances in client/src/redux/api/utils.js, used by ~55 API.get/post/... calls across client/src/redux/api/*.js; Express mounts /auth, /users, /posts, /communities, /admin in server/app.js; ~178 files
Rule 5 (size): 638 TS/JS source files (git ls-files; none under node_modules or build output, one minified pdf.worker), over 400

axios-baseurl: Vite React SPA with one axios instance (baseURL: VITE_BASEURL) in client/src/api/axios.js, ~17 api.get/api.post calls to /api/user|post|story|message/...; Express mounts those four routers in server/server.js; ~50 files

spa-plus-express: Vite React 19 panel whose fetch wrapper req(path) in ui/src/api.ts is called with literal '/api/...' paths (~35 one-line methods); Express 5 registers inline app.get/post/put/delete('/api/...') routes in server/app.ts; ~35 files

spa-plus-express: Vite React SPA (SyncUpFrontend) with ~11 axios calls to literal http://localhost:5000/api/auth|channels/... (two to /api/messages, whose mount is commented out); Express mounts /api/auth and /api/channels in SyncUpBackend/server.js; a second Update/Client + Update/Server pair; ~84 files without the committed SyncUpBackend/node_modules

env-api-urls: Vite React SPA with ~19 axios calls in client/src/api/*.js and store/auction/auctionSlice.js on env bases (`${VITE_API}/admin/...`, `${VITE_AUCTION_API}/...`); Express mounts /api/auth|user|auction|contact|admin|upload in server/app.js; ~97 files

spa-plus-express: Vite React SPA with 6 fetch calls to literal http://localhost:3000/api/... (usePlayerStore x2, AlbumTracks, Albums, Artists, Search), each a route; inline app.get('/api/...') Express routes in backend/server.js; 22 files

examined.reason: next-api-routes: App Router; ~40 direct fetch calls from pages and components on root-relative literal and template URLs (/api/settings, /api/git/status?projectId=${...}, /api/commands/run), plus form components that fetch a computed url; route.ts handlers under src/app/api; ~111 files

next-api-routes: App Router in JS; ~49 direct fetch calls in admin pages and buttons built by concatenation ('/api/feed/' + id, '/api/listpage/' + id + '/fetch'); route.js handlers under app/api; server.js is a plain http wrapper around Next's handler plus a cron job; ~130 files
Rule 5 (size): 1,582 TS/JS source files (most of its API is tRPC; 6 direct fetches to Next routes pass rules 3-4)
Rule 5 (size): 1,080 TS/JS source files (861 under src/); Next route handlers under src/app/api and at least 5 frontend fetches pass rules 3-4

next-api-routes: App Router in JS; 7 requests: 6 direct fetches (/api/creations, /api/upload, /api/headshot, /api/headshot/status, /api/user/apikey x2) and one axios.post('/api/checkout'); route.js handlers under src/app/api; ~37 files

next-api-routes: App Router; exactly 5 fetch requests, 4 in one-function helpers in app/_helper_functions (/api/summary, /api/getLatestPdf?userId=${...}, /api/uploadPdf, /api/vectorStore) and 1 in NavSidebar (/api/deletePdf); route.ts handlers under app/api (chat goes through ai/react's useChat, a library request); a Python backend reached only from the handlers; 66 files

Rule 3 (receiving side): the app's own API is tRPC only (app/api/trpc); its 3 direct fetches go to /api/uploadthing/delete, which no handler in the repo serves, and auth goes through the better-auth client

next-plus-server-monorepo: Turborepo with apps/web (Next) and apps/server (Express, app.use('/api/social'|'/api/match'|...) routers); ~25 fetch/axios calls on API_BASE_URL = NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || localhost:5000 (${API_BASE_URL}/api/match/finish/${slug}, a Sidebar-local base), plus one Next route call (/api/feedback); socket.io clients not counted; ~124 files

next-api-routes: App Router; ~17 direct axios.get/post/patch/delete calls in components on root-relative literal and template URLs (/api/forum/post/vote, /api/forum/${id}/subscription, /api/forum/post/?postId=${...}); route.ts handlers under src/app/api; ~190 files

next-api-routes: App Router; ~36 direct fetch calls in dashboard pages on root-relative literal and template URLs (/api/upstreams/${id}/test, /api/alert-rules/${rule.id}, /api/metrics?upstreamKeyId=...); route.ts handlers under src/app/api; ~110 files
Rule 5 (size): ~610 TS/JS source files (~390 under src/, ~180 tests, scripts, e2e) of 647 tracked; Next route handlers and many fetches pass rules 2-4

Rule 4 (calling side): its only React frontend (samples/next.js) sends every request through ZenStack's @zenstackhq/tanstack-query hooks (library code) to the app/api/model/[...path] catch-all; no fetch or axios request is written in the repo's source

next-api-routes: App Router; ~24 direct fetch calls in auth and dashboard components on root-relative literal and template URLs (/api/monitors/${id}/check, /api/user/profile, /api/status/${id}); route.ts handlers under src/app/api (an RTK Query baseApi with no endpoints); ~151 files
